children: On Oct 21 2026, the company notified Nasdaq of its intention to voluntarily withdraw its Class A common stock from The Nasdaq Capital Market and deregister under Section 12(b), with a Form 25 expected around Nov 2 2026 and delisting effective around Nov 12 2026. The company also plans to file a Form 15 to deregister under Section 12(g) and suspend reporting under Section 15(d). Its shares are currently quoted on OTC Pink under the symbol DRCT.
